data.name: Emerita
data.long_meaning: In Latin, the name Emerita comes from the Latin word 'emeritus', which means 'retired' or 'retired soldier'. It was a title given to women who had retired from active life and was respected for her wisdom and experience. It was also a title given to the wife of a Roman soldier who had served in a foreign province, as she would have accompanied him during his military service.
